t: The Articulate Ape's Blueprint: Cognition, AI, and Automated Chisel-Strikes
s: This article explores the intersection of human cognition, AI, and practical workflow optimization, positing that source video is now queryable data and that storytelling, not just brute force, drives innovation. It contrasts primal 'animal heuristics' with linguistic codification as dual cognitive processors.
sub: Data transformation of video sources into queryable assets
Dual process theory of cognition: 'animal heuristics' vs. linguistic codification
The role of storytelling and creative thought in technological innovation
Workflow optimization in the age of AI and advanced tooling (e.g., MoviePy, Nix)
Evolution of language from primal communication to codified systems
